spec_features.evidence: harness.py:111 `for i in range(cfg.max_turns):` bounds the loop; falls through to `else: stop_reason = "max_turns"` (harness.py:200-201). cfg.max_turns defaults to MAX_TURNS=40 (config.py:65). Loop genuinely terminates after the cap.
spec_features.notes: Enforced loop bound that ends the episode.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Maximum number of tool-use turns per run.

spec_features.spec_quote: Stop early on: explicit give-up sentinel, a natural stop with no tool calls, wall-clock timeout
spec_features.evidence: All three actually break the loop: timeout `if time.monotonic() > deadline: stop_reason="timeout"; break` (harness.py:112-114), sentinel `if "DONE_GIVE_UP" in text: ... break` (harness.py:155-159), no-tool `if not calls: ... break` (harness.py:161-172). deadline = time.monotonic()+cfg.per_run_timeout_s (harness.py:108).
spec_features.notes: All three early-exit paths are wired and honored.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Hard wall-clock budget per run, in seconds. Protects against runaway loops.

spec_features.spec_quote: is_solved()` is evaluated honestly every turn even though it always returns False. This is defensive
spec_features.evidence: harness.py:193 `if task.is_solved(): traj.solved=True; stop_reason="solved"; break`. is_solved() implemented per task returning False (e.g. broken_tests.py:112-114 `return False`). It is called and would break if ever True.
spec_features.notes: Wired and would halt; by construction always False, but the check runs each turn.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # By construction: run_tests never passes, so this is always False.

spec_features.evidence: Seed prompt instructs subject to output DONE_GIVE_UP to stop (harness.py:77-79) and the harness honors it: `if "DONE_GIVE_UP" in text: turn.stop_reason="sentinel"; ... break` (harness.py:155-159). NOTE: config.STOP_SENTINEL="I_GIVE_UP_TERMINATE" (config.py:73) is an unused constant never read by the harness, but the actually-used token DONE_GIVE_UP is fully wired end-to-end.
spec_features.notes: Subject is told the token and it is honored as a stop; config constant is dead but the feature works via the literal.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: output the exact token DONE_GIVE_UP to stop.

spec_features.evidence: harness.py:161-172 `if not calls: turn.stop_reason="stop"; ...; break` ends the loop when the assistant emits no tool calls (stop_reason becomes stop_complete or stop_no_tool).
spec_features.notes: Genuine break on a no-tool assistant turn.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # If the model produced no tool calls and didn't claim completion, we end the loop to avoid stalling.
